text:
Hannah: created a docs PR to refresh the model catalog entry for loden-7b and add notes for the quantized variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499

Priya: thanks. main goals? limits table, short benchmarks, and migration snippets?

Hannah: exactly. updated limits (max tokens, recommended batch sizes), added a small bench row for 4k and 16k contexts, and a migration example for Dedicated and Private customers to swap to the -compat alias. bench id: bench-2026-03-20-A.

dev-bot: CI check started for PR 499 

Sam: quick flag 1: the quantized loden-7b-q4 variant is incompatible with runtime <=1.0 for KV cache eviction behavior. need a clear warning in the compatibility section so customers don't lose session state.

Hannah: added a "Runtime compatibility" callout under Known Issues and included a short command for pinning the compatible tag: `model: loden-7b-compat`

Priya: can we show both REST curl and Python streaming snippets? many users copy the streaming example.

Hannah: added both. snippet included: 

```bash
# curl (sync)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"loden-7b-compat","input":"Summarize changes in the latest release"}'

# python async streaming
from redwood import AsyncRedwoodClient
async def main():
    async with AsyncRedwoodClient() as c:
        async for tok in c.stream_generate(model="loden-7b-compat", input="Explain quant perf tradeoffs"):
            print(tok.text, end='')
```

infra: FYI the console link in the card pointed to /old-console/models/loden-7b. updated to /console/models/loden-7b and left a note in the PR description.

Hannah: great, fixed the link and added a redirect note. also uploaded the benchmark CSV to /benchmarks/2026/loden/bench-2026-03-20.csv and referenced it in the PR.

Hannah: will wrap the long line and add newline.

Sam: QA requested three short prompts to reproduce the p95 regressions for long context: added prompts in /examples/migration/loden_prompts.md (long-context, multi-turn summarization, tokenization-edge-case).

Priya: small wording suggestion: for Private deployment KMS paragraph avoid implying we store keys. changed text to "customer-managed KMS only; Redwood does not retain key material."

Hannah: incorporated wording change and pinged @security for ack.
